description: §19.3.3 bare form (S441) — `fail .Nonexistent("x")` resolves `.Nonexistent` against the function's declared error enum `MyError` (§14.10 bare-variant inference applied to the `fail` target); `MyError` has no such variant, so the §19.3.3 validity rule fires E-ERROR-009 on the RESOLVED variant exactly as for the qualified `fail MyError.Nonexistent`. Incidental W-DEAD-FUNCTION/W-PROGRAM-001 ignored by superset matching.
rationale: §19.3.3: a bare `fail .Variant` resolves against the declared error type; the resolved variant SHALL be a valid variant of that type, else E-ERROR-009.
